anomalies.description: The dashcam vehicle swerves sharply right off the road, leaving the paved surface and entering grassy terrain while a truck approaches in the opposite lane; no collision is visible but the abrupt deviation suggests loss of control or evasive maneuver consistent with an accident event.

verification.reason: Frames f4 (49.5s) show the truck approaching head-on in the left lane while the dashcam car is still on road; by f5 (50.0s), the view has sharply rotated right and the road is no longer visible—only grass and trees—indicating the vehicle has left the roadway abruptly; f6–f9 confirm continued off-road motion. This matches a single-car accident (e.g., skid/evasive swerve), not a collision with another vehicle, but still qualifies as CarAccident per definition requiring a crash (here, crash into roadside/loss of control). The candidate’s interval aligns with the visible onset and continuation of the off-road event.
